import * as React from 'react';
import { Box, Typography, Button } from '@mui/material';

export default function CustomCard() {
  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        position: 'absolute',
        width: '328px',
        height: '519px',
        left: '20px',
        top: '559px',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        alignItems: 'center',
        padding: 0,
        backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
        border: '1px solid #293349',
        borderRadius: '16px 16px 0 0',
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
      }}
    >
      {/* Frame with Background */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'row',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          alignItems: 'flex-start',
          padding: '16px',
          width: '328px',
          height: '171px',
          backgroundImage: 'url(Checker.png)',
          backgroundSize: 'cover',
        }}
      >
        {/* Nested Bookmark */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            alignItems: 'center',
            padding: '8px',
            position: 'absolute',
            width: '36px',
            height: '36px',
            left: '276px',
            top: '16px',
            backgroundColor: '#F6F8FF',
            borderRadius: '50%',
            zIndex: 0,
          }}
        >
          {/* Icon inside bookmark */}
          <Box sx={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}>
            {/* Icon Component here */}
          </Box>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Main Content Area */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
          padding: '16px',
          gap: '40px',
          width: '328px',
          height: '348px',
        }}
      >
        {/* Title and Description */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            alignItems: 'flex-start',
            width: '296px',
            height: '180px',
            gap: '16px',
          }}
        >
          {/* Title */}
          <Typography
            variant="h6"
            sx={{
              width: '296px',
              height: '28px',
              fontWeight: '500',
              fontSize: '20px',
              color: '#1D1D1D',
            }}
          >
            Lorem Ipsum Title
          </Typography>
          {/* Description */}
          <Typography
            sx={{
              width: '296px',
              height: '72px',
              fontSize: '16px',
              color: '#878787',
            }}
          >
            Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur. Sagittis et viverra quam
            congue. Tortor aliquam accumsan nibh est non augue nisl vel dictum.
          </Typography>
        </Box>

        {/* Tags */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'row',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '8px',
            width: '296px',
            height: '22px',
          }}
        >
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              alignItems: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              width: '34px',
              height: '22px',
              border: '1px solid #293349',
              borderRadius: '16px',
            }}
          >
            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '12px', color: '#293349' }}>Tag 1</Typography>
          </Box>
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              alignItems: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              width: '34px',
              height: '22px',
              border: '1px solid #293349',
              borderRadius: '16px',
            }}
          >
            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '12px', color: '#293349' }}>Tag 2</Typography>
          </Box>
        </Box>

        {/* Action Buttons */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'row',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '8px',
            width: '296px',
            height: '48px',
          }}
        >
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            sx={{
              backgroundColor: '#00C26D',
              borderRadius: '4px',
              padding: '4px 52px',
              color: '#FFFFFF',
            }}
          >
            Action Button
          </Button>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
}
